### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report objective measurements (e.g., height, weight) exactly as stated in the transcript; do not perform unit conversions or add inferred values.
[A-Section]: Limit assessment statements to direct diagnoses, explicit connections, or stated plans for investigation made by the provider. Avoid inferring relationships between symptoms and diagnoses or suggesting unstated next steps.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report all objective measurements (e.g., height, weight, blood pressure) precisely as stated in the transcript, including original units. Absolutely do not perform unit conversions or add any inferred values.
[A-Section]: Strictly limit assessment statements to direct diagnoses, explicit connections, or verbally confirmed plans for investigation made by the provider. Absolutely do not infer relationships between symptoms and diagnoses, speculate on potential causes, or suggest any unstated next steps or investigations.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Strictly limit assessment statements to direct diagnoses, explicit connections *verbally stated by the provider*, or verbally confirmed plans for investigation. Absolutely do not infer relationships between symptoms and diagnoses, speculate on potential causes, or suggest any unstated next steps or investigations. Specifically, if the provider does not explicitly link a symptom to a diagnosis, do not suggest a possible connection (e.g., "could be related to").
